tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "What did Priya give you for your birthday?"
B hears the question and builds the answer. Put the blue verb in the past. A person tile (I, he, she, they) after the verb or after to / for becomes me, him, her, them.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.
